description: An eight by eight matrix mixer: each pad routes one input into one output, with an attenuverter on every output and eight scenes that crossfade into one another.

params.text: Routes that input into that output while it is lit, fading in and out over the times set by the two fade trimpots.
Silences that output whatever the pads feeding it are set to.
Short-press loads that scene, or stores the current matrix, input modes and output settings into it; long-press clears it.
Scales that output from -2 to 2, inverting it below zero.
Sets how long a signal takes to fade in when its pad is switched on, within the maximum fade time picked on the menu.
Sets how long a signal takes to fade out when its pad is switched off, within the maximum fade time picked on the menu.
Held high, selects that input column so that a trigger on a row button toggles the pad where the two cross; it exists so the matrix can be driven by MIDI mapping.
A trigger toggles the pad where this output row crosses the input column currently held high; it exists so the matrix can be driven by MIDI mapping.

inputs.text: One of the signals routed into the matrix; polyphonic, and its context menu can replace it with a constant voltage instead.
Selects the scene: a trigger steps through them forward, reverse, ping-pong, at random or shuffled, or 0-10V or a volt-per-octave note picks one outright.
A trigger restarts the scene selection at the first scene.

outputs.text: The sum of every input whose pad in that row is lit, scaled by that row's attenuverter; polyphonic.

notes: nothing reaches an output until a pad is lit: click the pad where an input column crosses an output row.
menu: Input mode — on an input's own display menu: Off, Direct, Linear fade, or a Constant voltage from the Subtract and Add lists, minus or plus one to twelve cents.
Scene lock — keeps the scene and output buttons working while stopping the matrix pads from being edited.
Channels — sets how many polyphonic channels are processed, one to sixteen; Limit output to -10..10V clamps each output.
Port SCENE-mode — Off, the eight Trigger modes, 0..10V, C4-G4 or Arm, setting how the SCENE port picks a scene.
Include input-mode in scenes and Include attenuverters in scenes — add those settings to what each scene stores.
Fade length — 4s, 15s or 60s, the longest fade the two fade trimpots can set.
Visualize input on pads — lights each lit pad by the voltage passing through it, green above 0V and red below it, in place of a plain white pad.
Scene, Count, Copy to and Reset — on the scene display's own right-click menu, for picking a scene, setting how many are sequenced, copying one, and clearing them.

inputs.9: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
